body:
Comments in tasks have some issues:

- Links pasted in should be converted to clickable links
- Guests are not seeing the name of a commenter in a task other than themselves, they just see "Someone." It's okay for a guest of a workspace and/or project to see and @mention other people in the workspace/project.
- For some reason guests aren't receiving notifications when they've been @mentioned

Also, let's implement a / command with some options:

- reference a task with /task
- reference a wiki page (and optionally a section) with /wiki

title: Comments in task panel need some QOL updates

body: @mention in all areas where @mention is available should allow the user to see the list of users who have access to that area/field and pick one. Otherwise the user has no guarantee the @mentioned user received the mention/notification.

body: The Wiki in all areas where it is available needs size adjustability. The user should have the option to resize the usable Wiki space.

body: The sidebar collapse button overlaps workspace button/dropdown when sidebar is collapsed. The best fix would be to slide the Workspace icon down below the collapse/expand button.
title: [bug] Sidebar collapse button overlaps workspace when sidebar collapsed

body: The green button above the account link should be labeled, and positioned correctly. I assume this green button is an "online" indicator.
title: [bug] Green button on UI needs fixing.

body: When adding a new project, focus should immediately switch to the project name entry field for typing in the name. Currently adding a project with the plus sign on "Projects" doesn't put focus on the Project name field and so the user has to click on the field manually before typing the name.
title: [bug] New project add; focus on name field
